description: This file defines common utilities, data structures, and macros used in the ANGLE project's shader translator component, including custom string, vector, and map types with pool allocators, as well as source location tracking.

classes.name: sh::TSourceLoc
classes.description: Structure to represent source code location with file and line number ranges.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts an integer to a pool-allocated string.

methods.name: AllocatePoolCharArray
methods.description: Allocates a null-terminated char array in the global pool.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Creates and initializes a stream with the classic locale.
